title: 2023 Topps Heritage Chrome Purple Refractor #402 Yoan Moncada Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Topps Heritage sports trading card features Yoan Moncada from the Chicago White Sox. The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 402. It also has a chrome purple refractor parallel/variety, making it a unique addition to any collection. 

The card is perfect for fans of Major League Baseball (MLB) and baseball in general. It is manufactured by Topps and is part of the 2023 season. This card is not autographed and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection.
